title: The LORD Continues: God's Creation

questions.question: Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you observe the calving of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:1 (ESV): "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you observe the calving of the does?"

questions.question: Who has let the wild donkey go free? Who has loosed the bonds of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:5 (ESV): "Who has let the wild donkey go free? Who has loosed the bonds of the swift donkey?"

questions.question: Is the wild ox willing to serve you? Will he spend the night at your what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:9 (ESV): "Is the wild ox willing to serve you? Will he spend the night at your manger?"

questions.question: Do you give the horse his might? Do you clothe his neck with a what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:19 (ESV): "Do you give the horse his might? Do you clothe his neck with a mane?"

questions.question: Is it by your understanding that the hawk soars and spreads his wings toward the what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:26 (ESV): "Is it by your understanding that the hawk soars and spreads his wings toward the south?"

questions.question: The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the pinions and plumage of what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:13 (ESV): "The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the pinions and plumage of love?"

questions.question: For she leaves her eggs to the earth and lets them be warmed on the what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:14 (ESV): "For she leaves her eggs to the earth and lets them be warmed on the ground,"

questions.question: Because God has made her forget wisdom and given her no share in what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:17 (ESV): "because God has made her forget wisdom and given her no share in understanding."

questions.question: He laughs at fear and is not dismayed; he does not turn back from the what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:22 (ESV): "He laughs at fear and is not dismayed; he does not turn back from the sword."

questions.question: He says among the trumpets, 'Aha!' He smells the battle from where?
questions.explanation: Job 39:25 (ESV): "He says among the trumpets, 'Aha!' He smells the battle from afar,"

questions.question: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up and makes his nest on what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:27 (ESV): "Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up and makes his nest on high?"

questions.question: His young ones suck up blood, and where the slain are, there is what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:30 (ESV): "His young ones suck up blood, and where the slain are, there is he."

questions.question: Can you bind the wild ox in the furrow with ropes, or will he harrow the valleys after whom?
questions.explanation: Job 39:10 (ESV): "Can you bind the wild ox in the furrow with ropes, or will he harrow the valleys after you?"

questions.question: Will you trust him because his strength is great, and will you leave to him your what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:11 (ESV): "Will you trust him because his strength is great, and will you leave to him your labor?"

questions.question: When she spreads her plumes, she laughs at the horse and his what?
questions.explanation: Job 39:18 (ESV): "When she spreads her plumes, she laughs at the horse and his rider."

key_verse_text: Do you give the horse his might? Do you clothe his neck with a mane?
